alerts.title: Viral load monitoring interval exceeded on DTG-based ART
alerts.message: Guidance for patients on two NRTIs plus DTG specifies viral load checks every 6 months, with reduction to 12-monthly only after VL below 50 copies/mL for over one year with reliable adherence. Patient P002 has had VL checks at 2024-09-15 (494 days before visit) and 2025-09-15 (129 days before visit), with no VL recorded since 2025-09-15 despite the 6-month interval being due. Viral load values are suppressed (30 and 20 copies/mL), so the regimen is not in question, but the monitoring schedule should be confirmed as current.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm the 6-monthly viral load schedule is current; order viral load if the last test is overdue. Reduce to 12-monthly only if VL has been below 50 copies/mL for over one year with reliable adherence.
